kills.property: After any call to NETM by the owner, the owner's balance equals totalDistributed (reference) — the mutant wrongly gives the owner totalSupply for some inputs, so balances(owner) == totalDistributed always holds in reference but not in mutant.
kills.change_summary: Replace assignment to balances[owner] setting it to totalDistributed with setting it to totalSupply (so owner ends up with full supply after NETM).

kills.property: For any caller calling NETM() (owner), the reference contract sets the caller's balances[owner] equal to totalDistributed immediately after the call; the mutant that zeroes balances[owner] breaks this by making balances[owner] != totalDistributed for some inputs.
kills.change_summary: Replace assignment to balances[owner] with zeroing the owner's balance (owner gets no tokens after NETM).
